summary: Frontend-only re-verification of the 'Value of Cars Covered in the last 30 Days' number-format fix on the Earn Rewards flip banner (home page, dealer Dave). Logged in as dave@fourbuy.co.za via the public preview URL, located the tile, and inspected the exact DOM text node. It reads: 'Value of Cars Covered in the last 30 Days: R11,757,000'. Character-code inspection of the number segment shows ONLY plain ASCII commas (U+002C) as thousands separators — NO U+0020 spaces and NO U+00A0 non-breaking-spaces inside the number. The Earn Rewards tile is otherwise intact (pagination dots visible, other bullets rendered). The en-US locale swap in /app/frontend/app/(app)/index.tsx line 210 (toLocaleString('en-US')) resolves iteration_42's outstanding separator concern.
critical_code_review_comments: index.tsx is 1016 lines — consider splitting into smaller modules in a future pass (not blocking this fix).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fix verified end-to-end: number renders as R11,757,000 with ASCII commas. No other regressions on the Earn Rewards tile.
rca_of_issue: Iteration_42 used toLocaleString('en-ZA') which formats thousands with U+00A0 (non-breaking space) rather than commas. Swapping to 'en-US' produces the requested 'R11,757,000' comma format.
